title: Pan latch strands across the settings modal; stale-anchor Pan intent lurches the camera on close
evidence:
mouse.odin: `if inp.panel_open {`
`// suppressed — the panel owns the surface`
`} else if inp.panning && !drag_eff && placing_eff < 0 {` ... `for i in 0 ..< moves_n {`
`append(out, Intent(Pan{dx = moves[i].x - inp.pan_last.x, dy = moves[i].y - inp.pan_last.y}))`
exec.odin Toggle_Settings: `inp.panel_open = !inp.panel_open` (no panning reset; begin_draw/start_run are the only other clears, both unreachable while the modal is open)
poll.odin: `} else if inp.panning && !rl.IsMouseButtonDown(.LEFT) {` (synthesizes a release every frame while the latch survives)
detail: S key (sel_pipe<0) or pad Y opens the panel mid-pan; the suppressed branch never closes the latch nor updates pan_last. On close, the per-frame Mouse_Move hits the pan branch and emits Pan with the full stale cursor displacement — a one-frame camera lurch.
recommended_fix: Clear inp.panning (and the latch anchor) when Toggle_Settings opens the panel, or in the panel_open-suppressed branch of mouse_map when panning is set.

title: Floor-clamped pullback keeps an off-center center; the new district can remain off-screen after convergence
evidence:
main.odin pullback_feed: `app.cam_zoom_to = z_to`
`app.cam_wx_to = cx_to`
`app.cam_wy_to = cy_to`
`app.pullback = true` (no camera_clamp_center call; cx_to/cy_to are the unchanged live center)
camera.odin: `z_to = clamp(min(z_x, z_y), CAM_ZOOM_MIN, CAM_ZOOM_MAX)` ... `// the fit floor: at 1.0 the full world rect is visible (the center pins` `// to the world center), so a floor-clamped target always includes the` `// district` — but the proc returns `center_x, center_y` unchanged, and camera_update applies no clamp
detail: Real map 1040x780 on 1280x720: at zoom 1.0 the y half-extent is exactly 390 = world_h/2 (zero slack). Pan to the top clamp (center_y≈97.5) at 4x, then a far SEED: z_to floors at 1.0, active, center unchanged — the district stays outside the converged viewport.
recommended_fix: In pullback_feed, pass the returned target through camera_clamp_center (as camera_zoom_at/effect_pan do) so a floor-clamped target re-pins the center to the world center.

title: camera_set_selection pipe leg (and camera_focus_pair) never clear the in-flight pullback flag
evidence:
node leg: `app.cam_zoom_to = 2.3`
`app.pullback = false`
`return`
pipe leg: `app.cam_wx_to = (ax + bx) / 2`
`app.cam_wy_to = (ay + by) / 2`
`app.cam_zoom_to = 2.6`
`return` (no pullback clear; camera_focus_pair sets `app.cam_zoom_to = 2.6` likewise without clearing)
Function comment: "Any selection change ends an in-flight pullback (the player's nav owns the camera)."
detail: Pullback in flight + pipe click-select (or crisis-banner focus) leaves pullback=true, so the selection focus eases at 0.05 (~1.5-2 s) instead of 0.14 — contradicting the function's own stated guard.
recommended_fix: Add `app.pullback = false` to the pipe leg of camera_set_selection and to camera_focus_pair.

title: Fractional wheel deltas (< 1 per frame) never zoom — no cross-frame accumulator despite the PR-body claim
evidence:
camera.odin: `f := f32(1)`
`for d := i32(delta); d > 0; d -= 1 {`
`f *= CAM_ZOOM_STEP`
`}`
`for d := i32(delta); d < 0; d += 1 {`
`f /= CAM_ZOOM_STEP`
`}`
poll.odin: `if w := rl.GetMouseWheelMove(); w != 0 {` (per-frame value; no accumulator state anywhere in poll/mouse_map/exec)
detail: Trackpads deliver fractional per-frame deltas (e.g. 0.1-0.5). i32 truncation makes every such frame a no-op, so slow trackpad scrolling never zooms at all; multi-notch fractional flicks (1.9) lose the fraction. The PR claims deltas "accumulate per frame and fire whole notches" — no such accumulator exists.
recommended_fix: Accumulate fractional wheel delta in Input state across frames; emit the Zoom intent with the whole-notch carry and retain the remainder.

title: SEED during an active pan drag: per-frame zero-delta Pan clears the pullback flag but the zoom-out target survives
evidence:
mouse.odin pan branch (runs every frame while dragging — poll emits a Mouse_Move unconditionally): `for i in 0 ..< moves_n {`
`append(out, Intent(Pan{dx = moves[i].x - inp.pan_last.x, dy = moves[i].y - inp.pan_last.y}))`
main.odin effect_pan: `app.cam_wx_to = nx`
`app.cam_wy_to = ny`
`app.pullback = false // the pan owns the camera — a pullback yields to the player` (unconditional, even at dx=dy=0; cam_zoom_to untouched)
detail: A SEED arms the pullback at frame top; the same frame's drag emits Pan{0,0}, clearing the flag. The zoom-out target survives, so the breathe-out runs at the normal 0.14 rate (~0.5 s), not the ruled 1.5-2 s band — neither a clean yield nor a clean pullback.
recommended_fix: In effect_pan, when the pullback was armed this frame and the delta is zero, either fully yield (revert the zoom target) or keep the flag; define the intended behavior explicitly.
